query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "mensajes_ai!", COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0)::BIGINT AS "input_tokens!", COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0)::BIGINT AS "output_tokens!" FROM agent_messages WHERE session_id = $1 AND sender = 'ai' AND ($2::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL OR created_at >= $2) AND ($3::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL OR created_at <= $3)
